changes.old: Contains the Visa-assigned business ID of the acquirer that signed the merchant for processing purchase or mail/phone order transactions. In this case, the acquirer is referred to as the Merchant Sponsor. The entry must be numeric. For transactions with a marketplace, payment facilitator or ramp ID this field will contain the payment facilitator, marketplace ID or ramp ID. U.S. acquirers must provide this field on all original presentments. For dispute financials, dispute response financial, retrieval requests, and fraud advices, U.S. issuers must retain and return the Acquirer’s Business ID if it was provided by the acquirer.
